question: Q01.01: The call round(number=3.14159, ndigits=2) passes its inputs as named arguments. How does its result compare to round(3.14159, 2)?

options.text: The named version raises an error because round does not accept keyword arguments.
They return the same value, since named arguments identify each input by name instead of by position.
The named version rounds to a different number of digits because naming the inputs reorders them.
They differ because named arguments always round to the nearest integer.
